reviews.review:
AnimaCircus is such a cute and simple rhythm game! Having said that, I want to break down my experience with the game. My experience was overall positive but there were a few *minor* issues. First, there's no screen resolution sizer. This isn't entirely a HUGE deal but could be helpful for streamers like myself! Second, the games rhythm arrows prove to be a little difficult. There has been a latency update which is great! But my biggest issue with the arrows, especially since there isn't a resolution size, is that they're sporadic across the whole screen. (bottom, top, middle, left, right). *Update 2/17/26 - Arrows sizing can be adjusted and changed now* I was having issues following along in some parts because I would miss notes due to them blending into the background or going across (in my case) the wide screen and not seeing it in time. Or making the notes more noticeable so they don't blend in with their environment. (EDIT** A beat border for the edges of your screen has been added, letters from the arrows can be hidden and there is a HUD enhancer that helps with background blend-in available now. Which improves gameplay tremendously imo!)
Aside from those two issues, the game is super sweet and enjoyable. I can tell this creator put so much love and work into this game. 20 whole songs and a fun secret bonus song you can unlock, unique to each stage and cat circus-act plus a good amount of customization for your circus cat (which I really hope to see more of in a future update or mayhaps a DLC?)! I do really recommend this game if you like cute and simple rhythm games. It has a ton of potential and I cant wait to see how the updates make this game shine even more in the future!
reviews.developer_response:
Thank you so much for your review, and I'm happy to hear you had an overall positive experience

On the issues you raised
- Good point on the resolution sider and I'm adding it to my backlog. It wasn't add yet because I didn't want to just put a resolution setting and not feel like it was properly implemented.
- About the arrows, I also intend to improve them. For now, I hope the high contrast mode in the settings (Gameplay tab) can help, it should make the background slightly darker to make easier to see the arrows, but let me know if that doesn't help either.

Again, thank you for your time writing your review and for playing AnimaCircus <3
(Edited because of a typo)
